notes.title: Major update for "Sphere of Influence - Ascension"
notes.content:
"NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Sphere of Influence - Ascension" has just added English interface and subtitles.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/375450/

To celebrate this major update, the bonus DLCs and 20% discount are being offered currently.
This offer is limited time only and lasts until October 31st, PDT.

notes.title: Update Information Ver. 1.0.0.1 (2016-10-6)
notes.content:
The following bug fixes were made:

- A bug in which the game would sometimes stop when attempting to start the game by using borderless window mode in Windows 10 has been fixed.
- Fixed other minor bugs.
